headline: Budget and enrollment, parking, turnaround plan renewal, and superintendent search updates.
summary: The meeting opens with public comment and includes reports from the superintendent and the receiver. The committee will also vote on minutes from three earlier meetings.
location: South Lawrence East Complex Auditorium, 165 Crawford Street, Lawrence, Mass.
